_comment: Tier 2 edge defense for Free/Pro plans: Cloudflare allows only ONE rule in
http_ratelimit on non-Enterprise zones (error 50001: N out of 1).
This single expression protects all /api/ paths except the Telegram webhook,
so Stars payment callbacks are never starved by the volumetric ceiling.
Full multi-rule design (coach/auth/billing split) lives in
name: clariora-edge-rate-limits
description: Volumetric IP rate limiting in front of Clariora Worker APIs (Free/Pro single-rule)

rules.description: API volumetric ceiling excluding Telegram webhook
rules._rationale: Free plan: 1 rule, period 10, mitigation_timeout 10. 40 req / 10s stops floods before Worker billing; Telegram webhook excluded. Upgrade plan for multi-rule / longer blocks (see rate-limit-ruleset.full.json).
